title: The decree was clear:
paragraphs:
The decree was clear:
Pray to anyone but the king… and you die.

When a law demanded compromise, Daniel chose faith over safety.
He didn’t protest. He didn’t panic.
He simply kept praying.

Scripture:
"My God sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths."
— Daniel 6:22

The lions’ den wasn’t just a punishment.
It was a test of loyalty.

Would Daniel bow to pressure…
or stand for God?

The world still pressures believers to compromise.
Silence your faith.
Hide your convictions.
Blend in.

But faith that survives comfort is common.
Faith that survives pressure changes history.
If obedience to God cost you everything… would you still stand?
